summary: Read the diffs and live state (registry equivalence 50/50/0 differing on prd, ArgoCDDeploy chart renders in S1/S3 diffed against the pre-slice base, schema refusals, mutation proofs, recommend-resources report+apply into scratch clones, the Architecture merge simulated then confirmed on the live dataset), and checked off verification.json: 22 verified, V15 and V24 owed to the operator's registry switch. Pushed Ansible ca536a6 (IaC/Build-Main #218 green, terraform plan 'No changes'; nothing to converge, so no iac-apply), ArgoCDDeploy 4afb8fb (AaC #9 green, argocd-prd still Synced at 307d94f, nothing live changed), JenkinsPipelineUtils 6f87d09, and Architecture d7c4878; that push turned AaC/Architecture #2068 red (P2's viewer test reads repo files the image build's build-viewer stage lacked), so the test-fixer's Dockerfile fix d73109d was pushed and #2069 is green, with the live dataset now free of the helm-charts producer (close-out N5). AnsibleSpecs is deliberately not pushed (A4). Owed to the operator: the registry switch — follow /work/Ansible/docs/runbooks/registry-switch.md steps 1-11, starting with the rehearsal `cd /work/Ansible && cexec iac kubectl --kubeconfig ~/.kube/config-prd-write --context prd apply -f support/registry-switch-rehearsal/applicationset.yaml` (step 3 re-checks with `cd /work/ArgoCDDeploy && cexec iac tools/registry-equivalence.py`), which settles V15 (A1) and, through step 11, V24 (A2).
